title: Make Ticketly keyboard friendly
prompt:
Three keyboard problems on one small page:

1. The pass buttons use positive `tabindex` values, so focus order jumps around. Remove them; the DOM order is already right.
2. A 2019 rule hides every focus indicator. Replace it with a visible `:focus-visible` outline at least 2px wide.
3. There is no way to bypass the header. Add a skip link as the **first focusable element**, with text containing "Skip" and `href="#main"`. It may be hidden off-screen, but it must be visible while focused (don't use `display: none`).
hints: Delete the tabindex attributes from the buttons entirely.
Replace *:focus { outline: none; } with :focus-visible { outline: 3px solid …; outline-offset: 2px; }
Put Skip to main content before the header, move it up with transform: translateY(-150%), and reset the transform in .skip-link:focus.
explanation: Without positive tabindex values, Tab follows the markup: skip link, logo, menu, then the three passes in the order they appear. The focus rule now adds an indicator instead of removing one, and `:focus-visible` keeps it from flashing on mouse clicks. The skip link is the first Tab stop; it stays reachable because it is moved off-screen rather than removed, and it slides into view on focus so sighted keyboard users see it too. Pressing Enter on it moves focus to `#main`, past the header.

checks.no-positive: No element has a positive tabindex
checks.skip-first: The first focusable element is a skip link pointing to #main
checks.skip-visible: The skip link is visible on screen while it has focus
checks.focus-ring: Links and buttons show an outline at least 2px wide when focused
